vietnameseItem: Cơm tấm sườn bì chả trứng
englishTranslation: Broken rice with pork chop, shredded pork, meatloaf, and egg
romanizedNoTones: Com tam suon bi cha trung
soundOut: kum tahm swoon bee chah choong
atAGlance: Cơm tấm sườn bì chả trứng is the maximal broken-rice plate: pork chop, shredded pork skin, egg meatloaf, fried egg, pickles, scallion oil, and nước mắm.
whatItIs: Cơm tấm sườn bì chả trứng is a full broken-rice combo with grilled pork chop, shredded pork skin, egg meatloaf, fried egg, pickles, scallion oil, and nước mắm.
howToEnjoy: Treat it as a loaded broken-rice plate: pork chop for smoke, bì for nutty chew, chả for softness, egg for richness, and nước mắm to tie the rice together.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm tấm sườn bì chả trứng when you want the works. Ask for nước mắm riêng if you want to control sweetness, salt, and chili on the rice.
worthKnowing: This is the loaded cơm tấm order, built from southern Vietnam’s broken-rice tradition: grilled pork for smoke, bì for chew, chả for eggy softness, and trứng for extra richness.
goodToKnow: This is one of the most complete cơm tấm orders; it can be a big meal.
travelerCaution: Contains pork, egg, and fish sauce.
